hook_text: 25 times 48 in your head in five seconds. Impossible? Watch.
clip_script: A bakery in Mbombela: 48 trays of 25 rolls. 25 times 48? Double one, halve the other! 50 times 24. Again: 100 times 12. That is 1 200 rolls. Same rolls, just rearranged. More tricks: 4 times 37 times 25? Group 4 and 25 to make 100. 3 700. 7 times 1 999? 7 times 2 000 is 14 000, take away 7: 13 993. And never forget: times 1 changes nothing, times 0 gives 0. Then check with division. Double it, halve it, check it.
visual_style: A tray of rolls being cut in half and rearranged into longer rows, with the numbers doubling and halving beside it.
mood: Clever and fun, like a mental maths magic show.
pacing: Fast trick, slow-motion rearranging tray, then a quick round of more tricks.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out 125 times 64 by doubling and halving.
